entities.name: UE operating in single-registration mode
entities.description: A UE that maintains one common registration for both 5GMM for 3GPP access and EMM when both 5GMM and EMM are enabled.

entities.name: UE operating in dual-registration mode
entities.description: A UE capable of N1 mode and S1 mode that does not require coordination between 5GMM for 3GPP access and EMM, except as specified in subclause 4.8.3.

entities.name: Coordination between 5GMM for 3GPP access and EMM
entities.description: The coordination procedure that applies only to UEs operating in single-registration mode as specified in subclauses 5.1.4.2 and 5.1.4.3.

entities.name: Coordination of SIM/USIM considered invalid
entities.description: Coordination procedure for handling SIM/USIM invalid status between various mobility management entities as specified in subclause 5.1.5.

relations.description: The coordination between 5GMM for 3GPP access and EMM only applies to UEs operating in single-registration mode.
Coordination between 5GMM for 3GPP access and EMM is not needed for UEs operating in dual-registration mode, except as specified in subclause 4.8.3.
The coordination of SIM/USIM considered invalid is a separate coordination procedure referenced from the general coordination clause.
